node.title: Rank-eleven absorbing clone-to-affine collapse
node.closure: coefficientwise cancellation of every high-core-absorbing full-rank clone curve to one affine owner
node.statement: For a positive-dimensional polynomial clone component whose correction space W contains all high core coefficients, choose an evaluation basis B of W. The basis equations force each correction-curve coefficient P_j to equal -H_j for j>=2, because H_j+P_j lies in W and vanishes on B. Hence H+P has slope degree at most one and is one global affine codeword owner line. Residual support-wise badness bounds that component by n'-m'+1=981105 slopes. Multiple affine owners and evaluation rank-flat components remain unpaid.
